audit_items.proof_trace: Race condition: two goroutines execute in parallel—one calls ProcessPayload→SetLatestExecutionPayloadHeader (caching header at line 222), the other calls validateExecutionOnBlock→notifyNewPayload (EL validation at line 231). No synchronization ensures EL validation completes before caching.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends malicious payload via P2P; consensus validation goroutine completes first, caching invalid payload header before EL validation goroutine detects invalidity, resulting in corrupted beacon state with unvalidated execution data.
